name: fortinet-fortidast
label: Fortinet FortiDAST
description: Integrates with Fortinet FortiDAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) to start and stop scans, manage scan schedules and scan configuration, and pull assets, scan status, scan results, summaries, recon data and JSON/XML reports into FortiSOAR. Ships a data ingestion chain that creates an alert per completed scan.

fields.title: Base URL
fields.name: base_url
fields.description: FortiDAST REST API base URL, including the /api suffix (for example https://fortidast.forticloud.com/api). Override for on-premises deployments.
fields.tooltip: The API paths (/v1.0/cmdb/..., /v1.0/query/...) are appended to this base.

fields.title: API Key
fields.name: api_key
fields.description: FortiDAST API key, generated in the FortiDAST console (Vulnerability Assessment > REST API). Read keys can call the query operations; privileged keys can also start/stop scans and change configuration.
fields.tooltip: Sent as the X-API-Key request header. The key is shown only once at generation time.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Verify the FortiDAST server TLS certificate. Disable only for self-signed or lab deployments.
fields.tooltip: FortiDAST deployments with a self-signed certificate need this off.

operations.title: Start Scan
operations.description: Start a vulnerability scan for an asset. Requires a privileged API key.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to scan, exactly as registered in FortiDAST (for example http://testphp.com).

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset (Get Assets returns it).

parameters.title: Scan Type
parameters.name: scan_type
parameters.tooltip: Quick Scan maps to scan_type=0, Full Scan to scan_type=1.

operations.title: Stop Scan
operations.description: Stop a running scan for an asset. Requires a privileged API key.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset whose scan to stop.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

operations.title: Get Assets
operations.description: List all assets (scan URLs) registered in FortiDAST for a user.

parameters.title: User
parameters.name: user
parameters.tooltip: The FortiDAST username whose assets to list.

operations.title: Get Scan Status

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to query.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

operations.title: Get Auth Status

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to query.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

operations.title: Get Scan Summary

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url

parameters.title: Asset UUID

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.title: Summary Type
parameters.name: summary_type

parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to query.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

parameters.title: Asset URL

operations.title: Get Scan Schedule

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to query.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

operations.title: Set Scan Schedule
operations.description: Create or update the scheduled scan for an asset. Requires a privileged API key.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to schedule.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

parameters.title: Enable
parameters.name: enable
parameters.tooltip: Enable or disable the scheduled scan.

parameters.title: Scan Date
parameters.name: scandate
parameters.tooltip: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.title: Scan Time
parameters.name: scantime
parameters.tooltip: Start time in HH:MM:SS format.

parameters.title: Frequency
parameters.name: frequency
parameters.tooltip: O=once, W=weekly, M=monthly.

parameters.title: Interval
parameters.name: interval
parameters.tooltip: For weekly frequency, 1-7 (Sunday-Saturday).

operations.title: Update Scan Config
operations.description: Update one scan configuration tab for an asset (authentication, coverage, exploit engine, forced browsing, HTTP or WAF). Requires a privileged API key. Pass the tab's fields as JSON in Config; consult the FortiDAST OpenAPI spec for each tab's fields.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset whose scan configuration to update.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

parameters.title: Section
parameters.name: section
parameters.tooltip: Which scan configuration tab to update.

parameters.title: Config
parameters.name: config
parameters.tooltip: JSON object with the tab's fields, for example {"authtype": "basic", "username": "u", "password": "p"}.

operations.title: Get OWASP Categories
operations.description: Return the OWASP category list FortiDAST scans for.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to query.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

operations.title: Get UI Link
operations.description: Generate a FortiDAST console URL fragment for an asset's scan results or configuration, for use in alert descriptions and dashboard links.

parameters.title: Asset URL
parameters.name: url
parameters.tooltip: The asset to link to.

parameters.title: Asset UUID
parameters.name: uuid
parameters.tooltip: The UUID FortiDAST assigned to the asset.

parameters.title: Link Type
parameters.name: link_type
parameters.tooltip: Which console view to link to. cvss_severity and the OWASP links take optional Severity and Category filters.

parameters.title: Severity
parameters.name: severity
parameters.tooltip: Severity filter for cvss_severity, owasp_category and owasp_severity links.

parameters.title: Category
parameters.name: category
parameters.tooltip: OWASP category filter for the owasp_severity link.

operations.title: Get Completed Scans
operations.description: List every asset of a FortiDAST user and return the assets whose latest scan is complete, each with a severity rollup of its findings. This is the data ingestion source operation: one record per asset scan.

parameters.title: User
parameters.name: user
parameters.tooltip: The FortiDAST username whose assets to enumerate.

parameters.title: Include Findings
parameters.name: include_findings
parameters.tooltip: Also fetch the scan's findings (one extra API call per completed scan).

parameters.title: Maximum Scans
parameters.name: max_scans
parameters.tooltip: Cap on completed scans returned per run, oldest first.

parameters.title: Since (Epoch Seconds)
parameters.name: since_epoch
parameters.tooltip: Watermark: only scans whose detected_ts is at or after this epoch second are returned, and findings are fetched only for those scans. Leave empty to return every completed scan.
